title: Icumbi ryiherereye ryiherereye
intro: Mu nkuru z’ubutoni bw’Imana, hari ubugingo bw’ubugwaneza budasanzwe, butandukanye n’abantu babo kugira ngo bashake ubwigunge mu cyerekezo gitagatifu. Ntibari bazi ko ubwo bwigunge bwari kuzana ikimenyetso ku isi yose, ikigeragezo cy’ukwizera cyari kuvugwaho iteka ryose.
clues: Nari nariyeguriye umurimo mbere y'uko mvuka.
Nahawe ibyo kurya biturutse kuri Allah byatangaje umurinzi wanjye.
Navuye mu muryango wanjye njya mu gace k'iburasirazuba.
Marayika yanyeretse mu ishusho y'umuntu utunganye, anzaniye inkuru y'umwana wera.
Ubwo nagarukaga nzanye umwana wanjye w’uruhinja, abantu banjye barandeze, ariko umwana yaranshyigikiye.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
